reasons.regional_outage: ap-northeast shows 14.2 percent payment API errors since 14:05 marked customer visible, with the synthetic checkout test failing and queue depth rising there.
reasons.response_plan: The priority 95 decision rule fires: customer-visible payment errors persist in one region, so declare SEV1 and page the incident commander; the matched release explains the timing and rollback likely follows within that plan.
reasons.technical_spread: The fault is concentrated in a single region while eu-west and us-east are healthy at 0.3 and 0.5 percent and the database is normal, which fits one region clearly degraded rather than multi-region spread.
